items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: We was trying to get a band together for King Floyd

ctx.x: I don't know, he lives in the project down here behind the, what is that, Basin Street? I don't know the correct address, you know, but he came here and auditioned for me. We was trying to get a band together for King Floyd and he came auditioned for me and told me he was considering this boy. I think he has another brother. That's the only relative he would have, yeah, to be those two boys. Oakland
Yeah, that's somebody I know I've forgotten about. I know I've met him once and we didn't really talk. I saw him once. He plays guitar pretty well.
